Messages.Author: Sten During
Messages.Body:
Some votes result in a vampire being burned. Can the acting vampire
play Soul Stealing to gain blood after the Referendum if the vote
was succesful?

Sten During

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Online rulings:

Soul Stealing cannot be used if a vampire is burned as a result of a political
action, such as Tradition Upheld. [RTR 19960124]

Julius cardtext doesn't say that. It says 'If Julius goes into torpor,
burn him.' It might or might not be interpreted as the controller of
Julius doing the actual burning no matter the reason why Julius went
into torpor.
